reviews.title: Don’t waste your money! A rip off. Many better apps out there
reviews.text: I Purchased the ab workout for lifetime membership and find that all it is is the same 30 exercises that are rated easy, medium, hard, and that there is no individualized plan. I’m just looking at this little video and mimicking the moves. It is certainly not worth $40! The app claims that I will have 500+ exercises and that all new contact would be automatically added. It seems like there is a lot of content. I saw this ad as a pop-up ad on one of my games and looked into it and purchased it. I then looked up other apps done by this developer who has very specific body parts and charges $30-$70 for each app. Talk about a rip off. I did not get 500+ exercises in my lifetime membership for this app And what is most frustrating is that every time I open up the app, I have to go through the whole process as if I’m a first time looker. I have to enter my height my weight my objectives and then I’m taking to the sales screen and have to go and hit restore purchases to get it up and going. Plus, I could only download one book - when I hit on other books it took me to the sign up to purchase page!! AND I can’t find the (supposedly) downloaded book on my devise!! RIP OFF. Do NOT waste your money
